context:
Four-phase implementation, each independently testable:

Phase 1 - Infrastructure fixes in unified_frame.py (21 queries):
  1A. Join equality decomposition: Store _eq_left/_eq_right operands in UnifiedExpr.__eq__
      result. In UnifiedLazyFrame.join(), detect single-expression left_on with _eq_left
      attribute and decompose into separate left_on/right_on items. (10 queries)
  1B. Fix DataFusion unique(subset): Replace select_columns+distinct with ROW_NUMBER-based
      dedup that preserves all columns. (6 queries)
  1C. Map "outer" to "full" in DataFusion join path. (1 query)
  1D. Fix unnest_columns API: singular method name for DataFusion v50. (1 query)
  1E. Add vstack() to UnifiedLazyFrame via union. (1 query)
  1F. Add melt() to UnifiedLazyFrame via union of per-variable selections. (1 query)
  1G. Add desc() to UnifiedExpr for sort ordering. (1 query)

Phase 2 - DataFusion v50 function fixes in unified_frame.py (5 queries):
  2A. UnifiedExpr.unique(): array_agg with distinct=True instead of df_f.distinct(). (1 query)
  2B. UnifiedListExpr.min()/max(): array_sort + array_element workaround. (1 query)
  2C. UnifiedStrExpr.split(): _DataFusionSplitListExpr proxy using split_part. (2 queries)
  2D. UnifiedListExpr.sum(): skip - no array_sum in v50. (1 query skipped)

Phase 3 - Window function plumbing (9 queries):
  3A. Add window_lag, window_lead, window_ntile, window_percent_rank, window_cume_dist to
      DataFusionDataFrameAdapter + ExpressionFamilyContext following existing window_rank
      pattern in datafusion_df.py:749.
  3B. Rewrite 9 qualify/window/timeseries queries to use ctx.window_*() API instead of
      non-existent Polars-style ctx.row_number/ctx.lag/ctx.avg methods.

Phase 4 - Remaining fixes (5 fixed, 3 skipped):
  4A. Add var() to UnifiedExpr. 4B. Add struct property + UnifiedStructExpr.
  4C. Fix sort_by DataFusion pass-through. 4D. Skip array_distinct (DataFusion Arrow bug).
  4E. Platform skip list: list_filter, list_transform, list_reduce.
description:
Running read_primitives on datafusion-df at scale 1.0 produces 41 failures out of 146
queries (72% success rate). The failures stem from 8 root cause categories spanning the
unified DataFrame layer, missing window function plumbing, DataFusion v50 API changes,
and query implementation bugs.

This plan fixes 38 queries and skips 3 that are genuinely unsupported on DataFusion
(list.eval() is Polars-only, array_sum has no DataFusion v50 equivalent).

Root cause categories:
- Join equality expression not decomposed (10 queries)
- unique(subset) drops columns on DataFusion (6 queries)
- Missing window functions in adapter chain (8 queries)
- DataFusion v50 renamed/removed Python bindings (4 queries)
- Missing UnifiedExpr methods: var, struct, desc, sort_by (4 queries)
- Query implementation bugs: wrong method names, select/filter ordering (4 queries)
- Join type mapping: "outer" not mapped to "full" (1 query)
- unnest API change in DataFusion v50 (1 query)
- Genuinely unsupported: list.eval(), array_sum (3 queries skipped)

anti_patterns.instead: all DataFusion-specific logic belongs in unified_frame.py or datafusion_df.py

modify the query implementations to be DataFusion-specific
anti_patterns.instead: fix the unified layer or context API instead
anti_patterns.why: the expression_impl functions must work on all expression-family platforms (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion)

anti_patterns.dont: use Polars-specific .over() chaining in rewritten queries
anti_patterns.instead: use the ctx.window_*() API which handles windowing internally per-platform

deferrals.summary: Full string_to_array support (returning actual list expressions, not split_part proxy)

deferrals.reason: No array_sum function in DataFusion v50. Would need unnest+aggregate workaround which is complex in expression context. Skipped for now.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: DataFusion v50 still lacks array_sum in Python bindings (confirmed in pyproject/code comments); workaround already documented inline; too narrow for a standalone TODO.

deferrals.reason: DataFusion array_distinct returns Dictionary(Int32,Utf8) instead of Utf8 elements. This is a DataFusion bug - skip until upstream fix.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Blocked on an upstream DataFusion bug fix for array_distinct Arrow typing; no evidence upstream has fixed it.
